description: Generate a "needle in a haystack" test: embeds a target fact into a large block of filler text at a specified position. Use this to test LLM context window retrieval accuracy. Returns the full haystack, the question to ask, and metadata. No API key needed.

needle.description: The fact to hide (e.g. "The secret code is ALPHA-42")

question.description: The question to ask the LLM (e.g. "What is the secret code?")

tokens.description: Target haystack size in tokens (default: 5000, max: 100000)

name: needle_haystack_generate
